summary: Comprehensive backend regression suite (39 tests) covering auth, vehicles, service, mileage, reminders, marketplace, forum, AI Mechanic, legal, CMS, admin, notifications, analytics, search, track. All 39 tests PASS. Frontend smoke tests for /login, /register, /garage (auth redirect), /gv91-admin, /legal/privacy-policy, /marketplace, /forum confirm pages render with premium dark theme + gold VEHIQ branding and cookie banner appears.

minor.issue: Reuses VehicleIn (make/model required) so partial updates return 422. Should use a separate VehicleUpdate model with all fields Optional.
IP-based lockout (_failed_attempts/_lockouts) stored in in-memory dicts — does not survive backend restart and is not safe across multiple processes/replicas.

action_items: Consider refactoring VehicleIn into VehicleCreate + VehicleUpdate (with Optional fields) so PATCH/PUT can accept partial bodies cleanly.
Move admin login throttling state out of in-memory dicts into MongoDB (persists across restarts and works across replicas).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py — register stores password_hash but _public_user does not strip it from DB — fine because find_one in /me path is filtered. Still, prefer explicit projection on every find.
vehicles.py — PUT uses VehicleIn (strict) preventing partial updates. Add VehicleUpdate model.
admin.py — in-memory rate limiting (_failed_attempts) loses state on restart and is per-replica, not per-cluster.
server.py VisitTrackingMiddleware — fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task on db insert; on shutdown some inserts may be lost. Consider awaiting or batching.
server.py — uses deprecated FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown; consider moving to lifespan context manager.
test_credentials: User: test_<uuid>@example.com / TestPass1234! (created at runtime). Admin: admin@vehiq.app / VehiqAdminTest2026!@#X (set up by tests on first run).
seed_data_creation: Tests register two unique users per run, create vehicle/service/mileage/reminders/listing/thread, and set up admin account with VehiqAdminTest2026!@#X if needs_setup=true. Vehicle is cleaned up at end (test_zz_vehicle_delete). Other test data persists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is comprehensive (39 tests, all green). Admin already configured in DB with password VehiqAdminTest2026!@#X — admin/setup-status now returns needs_setup=false. To test FRONTEND admin SETUP flow, you'd need to wipe db.admin_account first. Email-validator rejects .test/.local TLDs — always use example.com. Legal endpoint structure: GET /api/legal returns list with slugs {privacy-policy, terms-of-service, cookie-policy, marketplace-terms, contact}, each has title_pl/title_en/content_pl/content_en. Marketplace and Forum pages redirect to /login when unauthenticated (auth-required routes). AI Mechanic endpoint POST /api/ai/ask works end-to-end with Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM Key — verified non-empty reply.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — first-iteration testing, no failures observed.
